name: Default
shortDescription: Federated microblogging server on ActivityPub with notes, reactions, drive and timelines, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required: the instance URL is fixed to https://<domain>, and federation with other servers does not work over plain HTTP.
The domain and the ID generation method become the instance identity on the first start and cannot be changed afterwards, so deploy on the final domain.
Open the site after the first start to create the administrator account. The setup page asks for the initial setup password, which is the value of MISSKEY_SETUP_PASSWORD.
